summary: Older installations can move to the standard names, and the hybrid worker gets only the AD rights you choose.

new.title: Older installs can adopt standard job names
new.text: An installation made before 2.0.55 can switch to the standard job names with one install run. Each new job is proven before the old one is removed.

new.title: Hybrid worker gets only the rights you list
new.text: The hybrid worker's AD rights now go to one permission group, for only the tag attributes you list. There is no default list any more.
new.action: When you set up the hybrid worker's AD rights, list the tag attributes it may write.

new.title: One table of names in the guide
new.text: The install guide lists, in one table, every name you will see in Azure and Entra ID.
